criteria.text: Given the pattern set includes main and release/*, When I check main, release/1.2, and feature/x, Then main and release/1.2 are protected and feature/x is not
Given a repo whose project.json sets baseBranch develop, When the protected set is resolved, Then develop is included (backward compatible)
Given a dev adds dev,qa,stage,uat to protectedBranches, When the set is resolved, Then those names are protected in addition to the defaults with no duplicates
Given branch names are case-sensitive in git, When I check a name whose case differs from a pattern, Then it does not match
